messages:
sylvie: kicked off cross-region long-ctx GQA bench for Llama / Mistral / Qwen. initial p95 spike in apac-h100 — chart here: https://s3.redwood-inference/bench/1947778642/longctx-p95.png

jordan: saw that. p95 ~620ms in apac vs ~420ms eu-a100 for same batch/seq. did you use interleaved kernels or the fallthrough path?

sylvie: ran with interleaved + rope-compat enabled. config used: `--kernel-mode=auto --rope=gqa` and qwen was quant4a in this run.

rahul: can you paste the exact run command and model versions so i can reproduce locally?

sylvie: command i used:
```bash
./run_bench --model qwen-70b-v1 --backend h100 --region apac --seq-len 32 --batch 4 --kernel-mode auto --rope gqa --quant quant4a --trace kv_stats
```
also did the same with `mistral-7b-v2` and `llama-2-13b` (float16).

lena: infra metrics look suspicious — apac scheduler is interleaving micro-shards across hosts more aggressively. kv cache miss rate is higher there (infra dashboard -> s3://metrics/apac/kv_miss).

infra-bot: job/bench-1947778642 accepted. nodes allocated: 6 h100s (apac), 4 a100s (eu). logs: https://logs.redwood/1947778642

jordan: quick try: force `--kernel=attention_v2` (no fallthrough) + `--force-quant=none` for a sanity check. if tail is kernel-fallbacks, this should reduce p95 but maybe hurt throughput.

sylvie: tested `attention_v2` on a small subset earlier — p95 dropped to ~480ms but throughput down ~8%. sample run: `--kernel attention_v2 --force-quant none`

rahul: pasted numbers from the quick runs (csv):
```csv
region,model,kernel,p95,throughput_rps,kv_hit
apac,qwen-70b,auto,620,320,0.72
eu,qwen-70b,auto,420,360,0.88
apac,qwen-70b,attention_v2,480,295,0.75
```

lena: suggests hypothesis: apac p95 is dominated by additional kernel fallthrough latency + higher network jitter from cross-host KV lookups. two mitigations: a) force stable kernel for canary, b) enable local prefix caching to reduce cross-host KV calls.

sylvie: agree. i'll spin a canary using `--kernel=attention_v2` + `prefix_cache=local` in apac only and compare. saved diffs/notes to ticket RED-6213.

jordan: i can own the canary rollout. plan: 2h canary -> measure p50/p95/p99 + kv_cache_hit_rate and request tail logs. also add metric `kernel_fallback_count`.

rahul: add a small eval set for quality regression (we did change kernel + quant). run eval on the same prompt suite and check perplexity + answer BLEU-ish signals. we must avoid quality regressions when forcing kernels.

sylvie: good call. i'll include the eval harness and baseline artifacts in the ticket. eval run will be linked: https://s3.redwood-inference/bench/1947778642/eval_results.json

lena: infra-bot: can you schedule a short pre-canary job to warm the prefix cache?

infra-bot: warmup job scheduled: warmup-1947778642 -> 30m, target nodes apac-h100, action: pull prefixes to local cache.

sylvie: thanks. summary: run canary in apac forcing attention_v2 + local prefix cache, monitor p95/p99 + kv_cache_hit_rate + kernel_fallback_count + eval quality. ticket RED-6213 updated; @jordan owns rollout. :thumbsup:

jordan: will run tomorrow 03:00 UTC, will post results in this thread. :rocket:
